topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and frames how the concepts build on previously introduced immune components.

topics.label: Innate pathogen and damage recognition by pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infections and tissue damage through molecular patterns interacting with pattern recognition receptors and their intracellular signaling platforms.

topics.label: Cellular mobilization, leukocyte trafficking, and systemic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream cellular actions triggered by immune activation, including sentinel cell cytokine signaling, leukocyte extravasation to infected tissues, lymphatic drainage, and systemic pathologies like septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how acute inflammatory responses are brought to an end, how tissues heal or transition into chronic inflammation, and how unresolvable pathogens are walled off in granulomas.

topics.label: Conclusion and upcoming lecture preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the lecture closing and announces the topic for the subsequent session.
